stem: When a periodic force F = 6 sin 40πt (newton) is applied to a particle vibrating as x = 10 sin 44πt (cm), then:

options.A: The particle immediately starts vibrating at 20 Hz
options.B: The particle keeps vibrating at 22 Hz
options.C: After some time it vibrates at 20 Hz
options.D: After some time it vibrates at 21 Hz
